title: RAman For Thyroid cancER
brief_summary: Ex vivo vibrational spectroscopy (VS), including Raman spectroscopy (RS) of thyroid tissue samples, collected from patients undergoing routine diagnostic thyroid biopsies for diagnosis of potential thyroid cancer. Raman spectra are to be correlated with consensus histopathology and clinical outcomes. Multivariate analysis to be used to evaluate the classification accuracy of VS ex vivo.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patients undergoing routine diagnostic thyroid biopsy at surgery

Exclusion Criteria:

* Patients are unable to provide informed consent.
* Patients not attending for standard diagnostic biopsy for thyroid cancer
study_population: Patients attending for routine diagnostic biopsy
